people-ops: Quick drop 1  )

people-ops: Trying a tiny new format we call 'chef cards' 1 each card = 1-line result, 1-line proof, 1-line cook-request (who/what needed). Super short for skip-levels and calibration. Examples below — open to word tweaks.

people-ops: ```
[Eng] Result: Cut token cost 18% via quant+cache.
Proof: Batch jobs: $420-> $344/week.
Cook-request: Need 0.2 FTE infra for rollout (kevin).
```

sam.w: Love it. Can we add a format hint for self-reviews: start with "I" e.g., "I cut token cost..." so it reads right in a personal review.

maria: Tiny ask: include a one-line pasteable Slack variant like `Eng|Cut cost 18%  $420->$344  0.2FTE infra (kevin)` for fast threads.

leo: Suggest a short reviewer tag at end: `| conf: med` so calibration knows evidence strength.

people-ops: Nice. We'll add self-review prefix guidance, one-line paste variant, and an optional `conf:` tag. Canonical doc will live in people-ops and we'll publish next week.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: handbook page "Chef cards: one-line goal notes" scheduled publish 2024-08-05. :bell:
